title: Sunflower Girl Poses
description: A three-panel sequence on a bright green background showing the same anime-style girl with black hair, sunflower accessories, and a yellow-black outfit. Left panel: she stands confidently posing with one hand raised. Middle panel: she is mid-air in a dynamic falling or flipping motion with her long sunflower-tipped tail curling above. Right panel: she lies on the ground after the fall with small impact stars around her head.
prompt: Anime style illustration of a energetic girl with spiky black hair, large yellow sunflowers in her hair and on her outfit, wearing a yellow and black dress with matching boots and arm warmers, and a long black tail ending in a sunflower. Three sequential panels on solid lime green background: first she stands in a sassy pose, second she is tumbling upside down through the air, third she lies sprawled on the ground with impact stars, vibrant colors, clean line art
